title: Webhook delivery status values disagree with database constraint
notes: Cluster G from the final integration run: webhook transaction rollback, orphan pickup, and pause-subscription target tests insert pending, failed, or BOGUS values that violate webhook_deliveries_status_check. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 6576-6730.
root_cause: Initial hypothesis: application/test status vocabulary and the live webhook_deliveries_status_check domain diverged across migrations, leaving valid workflow states rejected or tests targeting obsolete values.
candidate_resolution: Establish the canonical webhook-delivery status enum, migrate the constraint and persisted data consistently, and update repository transitions/tests to use only that domain while retaining explicit invalid-status rejection coverage.
